workspace.title: Finance
workspace.description: Planning and financial structure for your organisation.

structure.pageDescription: Manage reporting groups and accounts for your organisation — no amounts or postings.
structure.emptyBody: Create reporting groups and accounts, or start from an optional template. Labels are yours; account types use SCE income and expense semantics.
structure.confirmDeleteGroup: Permanently delete this reporting group? Remove child groups and accounts first.

generic_income_expense_v1.name: Generic income & expense
generic_income_expense_v1.description: Simple starter structure with separate income and expense sections.
generic_income_expense_v1.previewSummary: Creates two reporting groups with two sample accounts each. You can rename everything afterwards.

overview.notConfiguredBody: Set a base currency and financial year when you are ready. No sample data will be shown.
overview.incompleteBody: Complete base currency, at least one financial year, and confirm setup to unlock finance capabilities.
overview.configuredNoDataBody: Budgets, actuals, and reports will appear here as you enable capabilities and add data in future releases.
overview.configuredCapabilitiesBody: Enabled capabilities are available from the navigation. Postings and calculations are not part of this foundation release.

settings.title: Finance setup
settings.description: Base currency, financial years, and enabled capabilities.
settings.structureOnlyHint: Configuration changes require finance admin permission.
settings.baseCurrencyHelp: ISO 4217 code used for organisation finance (not platform billing).
settings.financeYearHelp: Independent from sporting seasons. Define boundaries that fit your organisation.
settings.capabilitiesHelp: Choose the finance functions your organisation needs. You can change this selection at any time.
settings.starterNudgeBody: Start with Overview. More finance functions will become available step by step and can be added at any time later.

capabilityDescriptions.OVERVIEW: Key financial metrics and your current financial position at a glance.
capabilityDescriptions.MANAGEMENT_INCOME_STATEMENT: Compare income and expenses to see surplus or deficit.
capabilityDescriptions.BUDGETING: Plan income and expenses and set budgets for the financial year.
capabilityDescriptions.ACTUALS: Record actual income and expenses and compare them with plans.
capabilityDescriptions.FORECASTING: Estimate expected financial development based on current figures.
capabilityDescriptions.COST_CENTERS: Organise and analyse finances by freely defined areas or other structures.
capabilityDescriptions.PROJECTS: Track budgets, income, and expenses for time-bound initiatives separately.
capabilityDescriptions.FUNDS: Manage funds earmarked or restricted for specific purposes.
capabilityDescriptions.RECEIVABLES: Track open income and see which payments are still outstanding.
capabilityDescriptions.PAYABLES: Keep sight of open expenses and upcoming payment obligations.
capabilityDescriptions.COMMITMENTS: Record planned obligations before they become expenses.
capabilityDescriptions.APPROVALS: Manage approvals for budgets and financial decisions.
capabilityDescriptions.PERSONNEL_FINANCE: Reflect personnel costs and budgets in financial planning.
capabilityDescriptions.EVENT_FINANCE: Follow income and expenses for individual events.
capabilityDescriptions.GRANTS: Manage and analyse grants and funding separately.
capabilityDescriptions.LIQUIDITY: Monitor available funds and expected cash flows.
capabilityDescriptions.ACCOUNTING_INTEGRATION: Exchange financial data with external accounting systems.
capabilityDescriptions.UNIT_ECONOMICS: Analyse costs and revenue per unit or service.
capabilityDescriptions.REPORTING: Prepare financial information for different audiences.
